record.reason: HadamRNN parameterizes orthogonal recurrent matrices with binary or sparse-ternary weights and evaluates copy, MNIST, IMDB, GLUE and IoT tasks. It reports near full-precision task quality with compact low-bit recurrent weights. The approach is RNN-specific and not transformer/LLM inference; BERT quantization linkage is a weak low-bit analogy.
record.title: HadamRNN: Binary and Sparse Ternary Orthogonal RNNs
